text: {"verdicts":[{"i":12,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not mention having a daily inhaler or any regular inhaler use."},{"i":13,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient mentioned taking an antihistamine occasionally, not daily."},{"i":14,"v":"INFERRED","u":85,"why":"The patient mentioned occasionally drinking alcohol, which is inferred as OD (once daily) use."},{"i":15,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":97,"why":"The patient stated 'just my wife' when asked who he lives with."},{"i":16,"v":"INFERRED","u":10,"why":"The patient described fatigue and a rash on the calf, which are key components of the 6/52 history of fatigue and history of a circular rash on the calf."},{"i":17,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":109,"why":"The doctor explicitly stated the plan to do screening bloods for TATT including Lyme serology."},{"i":18,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not mention having a blinding headache."},{"i":19,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not mention having a headache."},{"i":20,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not mention a history of headaches."},{"i":21,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not mention any headache worsening with standing."},{"i":22,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":30,"why":"The patient explicitly stated 'No' to any change in bowel habit, including blood in the stool."},{"i":23,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not mention any rash."}]}
